According to https://www.iana.org/assignments/service-names-port-numbers/service-names-port-numbers.txt, 6456 is 'skip-cert-send' and 6457 is unassigned.

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22221/diffs?diff_id=1557934867&start_sha=e54c18ab180ac78f040be6d61943700cb25c501b#7f79cf40057a569b0b36a18130ee8100b48605fe_30_30)

Maybe better to use dissector_add_uint_range_with_prefererence().  Its up to you whether you want to 2 separate entries, the usual rule of thumb is if the protocol is not reserved in IANA is to pass in "", then let users add as many ports or ranges as they like.

You might want to also add:

dissector_add_for_decode_as_with_preference("udp.port", rttrp_handle);

?

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22221/diffs?diff_id=1557934867&start_sha=e54c18ab180ac78f040be6d61943700cb25c501b#7f79cf40057a569b0b36a18130ee8100b48605fe_1285_1275)

I got rid of the port registrations and use added the decode_as_with_preference.

The heuristic takes care of those ports anyway, so it still works the same.
